style_head: Low-poly 3D render, 16:9, cinematic studio lighting, neutral near-black graphite background (#191919 to #262626) with no blue cast in the darks. A small dark matte low-poly platform floats in the center; above it rises a glowing electric blue (#2383E2) wireframe object made of thin light lines:
style_tail: . Around it float a few dark matte polyhedra with faint blue edges, like in a minimal product render. Soft rim light, subtle floor reflection, lots of empty dark space, no text, no logos, no faces, full bleed, no frame.
